lines.text: In two unchangeable things it is impossible for God to lie, and this hope is a helmet for the soul.

problems.problem: Its true detail "God cannot lie" isn't in Hebrews 6:18 word for word.
Its wrong detail "God cannot rest" isn't found anywhere in the Bible.
Its true detail "God cannot lie" isn't in the Prep cards, so the walkthrough didn't teach it.
